What we check

  • Safety data sheets: on hand and up to date
  • Written exposure control and hazard communication plans
  • Staff training records
  • Sharps containers and disposal
  • Eyewash station access and checks
  • Protective equipment on hand

What you get

  • A written report, line by line
  • Every item marked: meets standard or action needed, with action items first
  • A clear next step for each item that needs one
